writhe0_lemma.statement: For any normalised Markov trace on H_3(q) (sum_lambda y_lambda d_lambda = 1, d = (1,2,1)) and any braid beta in B_3 with writhe 0 and pi(beta) = id: tr_M(beta) = 1 + y_(2,1) * (chi^(2,1)(beta) - 2).
writhe0_lemma.consequence_true: the SPLIT between y_(3) and y_(1^3) is invisible on such braids (only their normalisation-pinned sum enters).
writhe0_lemma.consequence_false: y_(2,1) is NOT invisible. Two conventions agree on such a braid iff they share y_(2,1) or chi^(2,1)(beta) = 2.

meta.rule: Any tau / tr_M value quoted below 0.1 % precision, and any cross-method comparison of trace values, must name its convention id from this registry with the script or Lean decl cited. Convention-silent trace values are not comparable.

channels.description: absolute nucleon / atom mass via the muon-anchored Hecke energy
channels.definitional_source: OWNER RULING 2026-08-09: convention C excised. The forcing is docs/audits/2026-08-08-mass-fibre-dimension-forces-convention-d.md — lem:feynman-eigenbasis-decomposition already writes the row cap ell(lambda) <= 2 into the mass channel's own decomposition (V = the fundamental of SU_q(2), summand count floor(n/2)+1), so y_(1^3) = 0 is a restatement of what the mass chapter uses, not an added premise. Feeding that into QOU.BraidsAndKnots.MarkovTraceTLUniqueness.markovWeights_eq_jones_of_threeRow_eq_zero (sorry-free) yields D uniquely. Superseded: prop:categorical-mass-markov + rem:markov-axioms-primitive, which SELECTED C — rem:markov-axioms-primitive says so in its own words, 'a stipulation of this definition, not a consequence of it'.

excluded_tracers.reason: NOT a Borromean trace and NOT a trace convention. It traces atom_braid_word_3A (computations/mass_at_3A_proper.py:256), which for (Z,N)=(1,0) is an 11-crossing word whose core is sigma_0^3 sigma_1^-3 -- a different braid closure from the 6-crossing interleaved beta_Bor = (sigma_0 sigma_1^-1)^3. Comparing it to a beta_Bor value measures a braid-word difference, not a convention difference.
excluded_tracers.incident: produced a false 6.7 % 'fifth convention' alarm on 2026-08-08 (bean qou-3qrv section 1)
